correctness.rationale: Replayed output/artifacts/verify.py -> VERIFY_OK with exact rational sympy arithmetic. Lemma 1 is valid: the flow of a Poisson field preserves pi and hence its zero set, so an isolated zero is fixed and the field vanishes there; modular and Hamiltonian fields therefore vanish at p. Proposition A verified: pi_c=f*pi0 has all Schouten components zero (A1), zero set exactly {0} with rank 2 off 0, vanishing 1-jet, modular field (-2x2,2x1,0,0) with nonzero linearization (A2-A3), all coordinate Hamiltonians divisible by f (A4), so the 1-jet obstruction rules out every Hamiltonian trivialization for every volume choice (A5). Proposition B verified: Jacobian pi_J satisfies Jacobi (J1), two Casimirs (J2), pencil identity det(sA+tB)=(s^2+t^2)^2 (J3), isolation pi13+pi24=|x|^2 forcing real zero set {0} and rank exactly 2 off 0 (J4 plus dC1 nonzero off origin), identically zero modular field (J5), vanishing 1-jet (J6). The dichotomy theorem follows; sign conventions do not affect zero/nonzero verdicts.
